summary: Nora can read a shared document, spreadsheet, slide deck or PDF when somebody asks about a file they sent a link to, once the operator signs in her own read-only account and switches it on.
details: She opens a file only when asked, by the link's handle or a pasted link, and reads it fresh every time: nothing from the file is kept.
A long file is read in parts, and she says which part she read.
A file nobody shared with her gets an answer saying to share it with nora@67.zone as a Viewer; a deleted, oversized or download-locked file is said to be so.
Read-only: she cannot change, comment on or share the file.
limitations: Off until the operator runs the one-time sign-in, puts the credentials in .env and sets [external_files] enabled = true; until then she says she can't open shared files.
Slides read as one text, not numbered per slide; images and charts in a file are not read.
Copying a file to her computer is not built yet.
